toronto-labatt-river-towers.summary: Two 46-storey residential buildings at Labatt Avenue and River Street, with 1,170 homes and a two-storey non-residential building.

toronto-augusta-hotel.summary: A six-storey hotel with a restaurant at 309–311 Augusta Avenue, containing 2,194 square metres of non-residential floor area.

toronto-neilson-medical-housing.summary: A six-storey residential building behind the existing three-storey medical building at 1333 Neilson Road; the medical building would remain.

toronto-lawrence-heights-revitalization.summary: Phase 2 of Lawrence Heights revitalization proposes new and reconfigured streets, parks, community uses and housing from 6 to 25 storeys, including replacement social housing, new affordable housing and market homes.

toronto-lawrence-heritage-intention.summary: Proposed heritage designation of the arena at 2125 Lawrence Avenue West, recognizing its architecture, recreational history and relationship to Weston.

toronto-weston-heritage-demolition.summary: The notice records conditional approval of alterations and removal of a specified heritage attribute at 1151 Weston Road for a 46-storey mixed-use building, subject to a satisfactory relocation and conservation plan.

toronto-stotts-bridge-heritage.summary: The notice records conditional approval to demolish Stotts’ Bridge and construct a temporary bridge pending a permanent truss replacement. Conditions include documentation and consideration of salvage.

toronto-queen-heritage-amendment.summary: Proposed changes to the heritage designation for 339 Queen Street East would expand its historical reasons and recognize its Chicago School architecture and historic timber frame.

toronto-nightclub-definition.summary: Proposed licensing changes would exclude premises with an occupant load under 151 from the nightclub definition and license them according to their operations. A related direction would examine alignment with zoning.

features.label: Licensing and zoning alignment
features.anchor: strengthen alignment of business licensing and zoning

toronto-street-vending-rules.summary: Proposed street-vending and artists by-law changes include lifting a sidewalk-vending moratorium, extending mobile vending time on the same block from five to twelve hours, and introducing a new permit regime.

toronto-rentsafeto-fees.summary: Proposed RentSafeTO fee changes include a variable $42.73–$46.81 fee for reissuing an apartment-building colour-coded sign, specified social-housing exemptions and changes to remedial-work fees.
